args.title: Fix export functionality not working in Safari
args.body:
File: src/export/

The export functionality is not working as intended in Safari, where clicking Export shows 'Exporting...' but no file is downloaded. This fix aims to address the issue that prevents the download from occurring in Safari, ensuring users are able to download files in both CSV and XLSX formats.
